verdict.rationale: A live probe shows https://serpapi.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a SerpApi overview. Probes also show markdown versions of the doc pages exist (e.g. search-api.md, integrations.md, markdown-output.md, google-ads-api.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: evidence of how comprehensive the llms.txt index is (e.g. an llms-full.txt), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent community reports of agents using these docs.
